key_insight: NUMINA is a training‑free identify‑then‑guide framework that extracts a countable latent layout from discriminative attention heads and conservatively modulates cross‑attention to fix prompt–layout mismatches, improving numerical alignment in text‑to‑video diffusion models.
problem_solved: Text‑to‑video diffusion models frequently fail to generate the correct number of objects specified in prompts, producing prompt–layout inconsistencies and incorrect counts in synthesized videos.
method: Identify: select discriminative self‑ and cross‑attention heads to derive a countable latent layout representing object instances.
Refine: conservatively adjust the latent layout to avoid overcorrection and preserve visual fidelity.
Guide: modulate cross‑attention during regeneration to align visual instances with textual numerals — all without additional training.
impact: Enables more reliable, controllable video synthesis that respects numeric prompt constraints without retraining models, benefiting practitioners who need accurate instance counts for generation, evaluation, or downstream tasks.

paper_title: When Numbers Speak: Aligning Textual Numerals and Visual Instances in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
